A1.justification: Both PDFs describe ActionPiece, with matching methods, experiments and appendices. Inspection of all 19 pages of v1 and 21 pages of v2, including rendered figures, tables and equations, supports a reliable comparison.

before.justification: Section 4 reports original ActionPiece recommendation experiments, ablations, token-utilization measurements and inference-ensembling analyses on Amazon Sports, Beauty and CDs.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results and adds smaller-vocabulary TIGER controls and a TIGER+SPR experiment in Table 5.

M1.justification: Weighted token merging, intermediate nodes, SPR segmentation, Transformer training and inference ensembling remain unchanged. Appendix H newly clarifies unmerged target labels and decoding details; the PDFs do not establish a change to the underlying procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate next-item recommendation on the same Amazon Sports, Beauty and CDs datasets. The added discussions of LLM alignment and feature crossing introduce no new evaluated datasets, tasks or domains.

E2.justification: The main baseline set is unchanged, but v2 Table 5 adds TIGER+SPR as an evaluated comparison variant. Newly cited LLM and feature-crossing methods are not additional experimental baselines.

E3.justification: v2 extends the ablation settings with TIGER vocabularies of 192 tokens (4×48) and 768 tokens (3×256), and a control applying SPR to TIGER. Existing splits, metrics, training budgets, model configurations and ActionPiece hyperparameters remain unchanged.

E4.justification: The vocabulary-size ablation now tests shrinking as well as enlarging TIGER's vocabulary. The new TIGER+SPR control tests whether permutation alone benefits a context-independent tokenizer. Existing component ablations, Figures 4–6 and the case study are retained.

E5.justification: Both versions specify five runs with seeds 2024–2028 and retain the same averaging and ± reporting practices. No new uncertainty-estimation procedure, significance test or increased run count is reported.

E6.justification: v2 Table 5 adds results for TIGER-192, TIGER-768 and TIGER+SPR. TIGER+SPR obtains NDCG@10 of 0.0202, 0.0330 and 0.0351 on Sports, Beauty and CDs, below the retained TIGER results. All main performance-table values, previously reported ablation scores and plotted results remain unchanged.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, co-occurrence probabilities in Equations (1)–(2), and Appendix C.2's vocabulary-construction complexity derivation are unchanged. Algorithm comment capitalization and line numbering introduce no mathematical revision.

C1.justification: The abstract drops its explicit experimental-superiority statement and the 6.00%–12.82% NDCG@10 improvement range, narrowing its headline contribution summary. Section 4.2 retains that claim, while the context-aware tokenization novelty and principal methodological contributions remain unchanged.

C2.justification: v2 explains TIGER+SPR's poorer results through disrupted semantic-ID ordering without changed token frequencies. Section 3.4 adds an efficiency argument based on asynchronous permutation and parallel inference, while Appendix E connects existing results to data-level versus model-level feature crossing. The latency assertions have no accompanying timing measurements.

D1.justification: v2 supplies a code repository link and newly explains CPU-based asynchronous permutation, original unaugmented and unmerged target labels, and beam-search termination. The architecture, hardware, seeds and Table 7 hyperparameters were already documented in v1 and are retained.

R1.justification: New Appendix D substantially expands positioning through a taxonomy of LLM–action alignment, adding works such as TALLRec, LLaRA and CoLLM. Appendix E.2 introduces a separate connection to feature-crossing research, including Deep Crossing, DCN/DCN v2 and CAN, distinguishing their model-level interactions from ActionPiece's data-level merging.

P1.justification: v2 adds Section 3.4 and explanatory appendices, moves the BPE discussion into the main text, and revises the abstract and ablation narrative. It also adds acknowledgements and an impact statement and removes the redundant Reproduction summary. Most existing methodological and experimental prose remains intact.

P2.justification: The BPE comparison and dataset-statistics tables move from v1's appendix Tables 5–6 to v2's main-text Tables 2–3, with resizing. The ablation table gains rows and a footnote; Algorithm 1 changes position, and some captions and diagram labels receive small edits. Existing plotted evidence is retained.

improvement.justification: The added vocabulary-size and TIGER+SPR controls strengthen the evidence for ActionPiece's benefits. Clarified target-label handling, code access information and expanded research positioning also improve the paper. These are bounded gains: the principal results remain unchanged, the abstract loses its performance summary, and the new latency assertions lack timing measurements.
